title: New meaning for an old number
objective: Find a scalar that Unicode 15.1 NFKC leaves unchanged but Unicode 17 NFKC maps to ASCII.

inputs.label: Text
inputs.description: Look for a character assigned after Unicode 15.1.

graphDescription: The same scalar sequence passes through independent Unicode 15.1 and Unicode 17 WASM modules.
hints: An unassigned scalar has no compatibility mapping in an older Unicode version.
Unicode 16 added a modifier form whose compatibility decomposition is an ASCII letter.
Search the character lab for U+A7F1 MODIFIER LETTER CAPITAL S.
explanation: U+A7F1 was unassigned in Unicode 15.1, so that engine preserves it. Its later assignment includes a compatibility decomposition to ASCII S, which Unicode 17 NFKC applies. Historical behavior requires historical data—not just a different label.
